title: Multi-Line Split Log Formats
damaged_code:
```rust
// Rust
info!("User login failed\nIP: {}\nReason: {}", ip, reason); // Spans multiple lines
```
pattern: Emitting log records containing explicit newline characters (`\n`), splitting a single log event across multiple physical lines.
why_bad: It breaks standard log parsing tools (`grep`, `awk`, log aggregators). Line-oriented utilities cannot correlate split log entries, defeating automated monitoring and parsing scripts.
detection: Logging macro invocations containing explicit newline characters in their format string.
fix:
Use structured JSON logging or format log entries on a single physical line with key-value descriptors.
```rust
info!(target: "login_failures", ip = ?ip, reason = ?reason, "User login failed");
```
